written_before: any model of this run was trained, exported or scored
question: do (1) deterministic label-preserving augmentation, (2) soft-label training that also uses the notes Clef was unsure about, and (3) the annotation-v4 rules (R1 `X tra ...`, R2 on-behalf, R3 sending money to people, R4 salary phrasing) given to the Clef teacher improve encoder 1 over clef-distill-v1 arm A seed 1 (the current candidate) and the released gidi-finance-v3?
rules: docs/annotation-v4.md, configs/annotation-v4.yaml (user-approved rules from experiments/v3-field-issues.md). Existing human/LLM labels are not changed; conflicts are only listed in datasets/annotation-v3/distill-clef-02/rule-conflicts.jsonl.
teacher: Clef 16-shot kNN with the frozen rule-aware prompt (scripts/clef_teacher.py). Dev sets used to freeze the prompt: the 17 field-case notes and the validation split; never the held-out sets below. Labels are model labels, never human labels.
amendment_1: written after the rule-aware labels existed and before any training: the frozen rule-aware Clef prompt fails two lexically clear cases (R2 `tra/ung/mua/dong ho|giùm|dùm X ...` is labelled expense in 87 of 105 rule notes; `ung luong` / `tam ung` is labelled borrow in only 11 of 36). For those rows only, a deterministic lexical override sets the soft type distribution to the rule type (R2 -> lend, ung luong / tam ung -> borrow, probability 0.95 on that type, the rest spread uniformly) and records `provenance.override = 'R2' | 'R4-ung'`; the target stays Clef's choice and is trusted only when its probability >= 0.6. Applied to every row of labels-all.jsonl, the old pool included. No other label is overridden.

data.augment-01: deterministic transforms of training-v5 train only (lowercase target, strip diacritics, glue amounts); labels unchanged
data.soft silver: datasets/annotation-v3/distill-clef-02/labels-all.jsonl: every rule-aware Clef-labelled note, no threshold on notes; type trained on Clef probabilities, span loss kept only when target prob >= 0.6 (target_trusted)
data.rule notes: about 500 new hand-written R1-R4 notes, gated against test, probe-v1, probe-rules-v1, human-value-01/02

arms.arm_A_v1: clef-distill-v1 arm A (training-v6a, hard silver-A); stored results are the control
arms.D2: training-v5 train + augment-01 + soft silver of the old 1,757-note pool (ideas 1 + 2; the labels come from the rule-aware prompt, so the prompt change is confounded with the soft labels here)
arms.D3: D2 + soft silver of the new rule notes (ideas 1 + 2 + 3), the release-candidate arm

release_candidate.rule: D3 seed 1, word snap on. Fixed now: not chosen among arms or seeds by any held-out score; no seed re-run, dropped or swapped after scoring.

recipe: unchanged from clef-distill-v1 / retrain-v5 except the soft type loss and the span mask for records with `soft`; all records equal weight; seeds 1, 2, 3 for D1, D2, D3
held_out_scored_in_this_run: human-value-02 (190 complete, LLM labels, reused test set)
probe-rules-v1 (64 notes, LLM labels, evaluation only, written independently from the rule text; new, so the only set that measures R1-R4)
success_criterion: D3 seed 1 type+target exact on probe-rules-v1 >= 0.10 above both arm A seed 1 and v3, AND no drop larger than 0.02 against arm A seed 1 on each of: frozen test type macro-F1, frozen test target exact, probe-v1 type macro-F1, human-value-01 end-to-end exact, human-value-02 end-to-end exact. Also report each seed and the three-seed mean for D1, D2, D3, the 17 field cases per system (dev only), and nothing is selected by them.
no_tuning: no threshold, prompt, augmentation set or data selection is changed after seeing held-out numbers. If the criterion fails it is reported as a failure and the next step is a user decision.

d4.written_before: any D4 model was trained, exported or scored; written after the D1-D3 results (verdict FAIL) were known, on the user's approval of one follow-up arm
d4.question: does the hard-label route (arm A style: no soft field, silver kept only where Clef is confident) plus the new R1-R4 rule notes keep arm A's span quality on the human sets while gaining on probe-rules-v1? D1-D3 suggest the soft silver (or the relabelled old pool) cost span quality; D4 drops both and keeps only the rule notes.
d4.data: training-v7-d4 = training-v7-d1 (training-v5 train + training-v6a hard silver-A (rows that hit probe-rules-v1 dropped, as in D1) + augment-01) + the `rules` shard of datasets/annotation-v3/distill-clef-02/labels-all.jsonl, HARD labels (no `soft` field), kept only when type prob >= 0.6 and target prob >= 0.6 (the silver-A rule of distill-clef-01). amendment_1 overrides (R2 -> lend, R4-ung -> borrow, type prob 0.95) are applied as in D2/D3 before the filter. The old-pool relabels (s01..s20) are NOT used. Same leakage gates and drops as D1-D3 (extended with probe-rules-v1).
d4.recipe: identical to D1: teacher cache built from exactly training-v7-d4/train.jsonl with the same bamibert teacher, scripts/train_student.py with the D1 flags (supervised, student-4x768, 40 epochs, lr 5e-5, head-lr 1e-3, same vocab/ffn maps), seeds 1, 2, 3. Nothing else changes.
d4.release_candidate: D4 seed 1, word snap on; fixed now, not chosen by any held-out score; no seed re-run, dropped or swapped after scoring.
d4.success_criterion: D4 seed 1 type+target exact on probe-rules-v1 >= 0.10 above both arm A seed 1 and v3, AND no drop larger than 0.02 against arm A seed 1 on each of: frozen test type macro-F1, frozen test target exact, probe-v1 type macro-F1, human-value-01 end-to-end exact, human-value-02 end-to-end exact. Also report each seed and the three-seed mean, D1/D2/D3 stay as scored, the 17 field cases (dev only).
d4.no_tuning: same as v2: no threshold, data selection or recipe change after seeing held-out numbers; a failed criterion is reported as a failure.
